name: transactions-agent
description: Answers questions about what actually happened on a customer account: charges, merchants, dates, recurrence and refunds. Knows the individual case, not the broader pattern.

skills.name: Investigate a charge
skills.description: Given a customer and a charge description, finds the matching charge and reports the merchant, amount, date, whether it recurs, how many times it has occurred and whether it was refunded.
examples: Customer 1042 has an unrecognized charge of 49.90
What was charged to customer 1087 in September?

skills.name: List charges
skills.description: Lists every charge on a customer account, useful when the customer cannot specify which charge they are questioning.
